_comment: Route R2: one measured solubility in the same oil at 25 C (curcumin in corn oil, 0.07 mg/mL; Joung et al. 2016 as compiled by Araiza-Calahorra et al. 2018) is used to predict hotter oil. Literature value at 100 C: 3-4 mg/mL.
